options.name: title
options.description: Accessible name, rendered as the heading (text only). Must be non-empty after trimming.

options.name: description
options.description: Referenced by aria-describedby (text only). Hidden when empty.

options.name: content
options.description: Body content; strings render as text. Inserted at construction and again only when update() passes `content`.

options.name: snapPoints
options.description: Heights as fractions of the viewport height, strictly ascending, each in (0, 1]. Without snap points the sheet fits its content (capped at 90dvh). Two or more make the handle a slider.

options.name: snap
options.description: Index into snapPoints used when the sheet opens (0 = lowest). Must be 0 without snap points. When set, open() re-applies it.

options.name: modal
options.description: true: showModal() with inert background, backdrop and scroll lock. false: show(); the page stays interactive (supplementary panels only).

options.name: closeOnEscape
options.description: Escape requests close (cancelable, reason 'escape') when the sheet is the topmost overlay.

options.name: closeOnBackdrop
options.description: Backdrop click requests close (cancelable, reason 'backdrop'). Modal only.

options.name: closeOnDragDown
options.description: Dragging the handle down past min(120px, 25% of the lowest height) requests close (cancelable, reason 'drag').

properties.name: element
properties.description: The native dialog element (appended to document.body at creation).

properties.name: handle
properties.description: The drag handle strip: role=slider with two or more snap points, otherwise aria-hidden.

properties.name: modal
properties.description: Whether the sheet was created modal.

properties.name: snap
properties.description: Current snap point index (0 without snap points).

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open (modal: showModal() and scroll lock; non-modal: show()); moves focus inside, captures focus for restoration, registers with the overlay stack, emits aui-open. No-op when open.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close programmatically (not cancelable, reason 'programmatic'). No-op when closed.

methods.name: snapTo
methods.description: Move to a snap point programmatically; no event. Throws BOTTOM_SHEET_OPTIONS for an index outside snapPoints.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (all except modal). Validates the merged options first; a failed update keeps the previous state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close if open (restoring focus and scroll), then remove the element, listeners, drag tracking, overlay registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-cancel
events.description: Before a user-initiated close; preventDefault keeps it open (a dismissing drag snaps back).

events.name: aui-snap-change
events.description: The user changed the snap point (keyboard, handle click, or drag release). value is the viewport fraction. Not emitted by snapTo() or update().

cssClasses.name: aui-bottom-sheet--snapped
cssClasses.description: A snap point is active; block-size is calc(100dvh * --aui-bottom-sheet-snap).

cssClasses.name: aui-bottom-sheet--dragging
cssClasses.description: A handle drag is in progress; transitions are off.

cssClasses.name: aui-bottom-sheet--static
cssClasses.description: Set on open when motion is disabled (reduced motion or animation 'none'); removes transitions.

cssClasses.name: aui-bottom-sheet__handle
cssClasses.description: Full-width drag strip (shown first through CSS order).

cssClasses.name: aui-bottom-sheet__grip
cssClasses.description: Visual grip bar inside the handle.

cssClasses.name: --aui-bottom-sheet-snap
cssClasses.description: Custom property set through the CSSOM: active snap fraction.

cssClasses.name: --aui-bottom-sheet-offset
cssClasses.description: Custom property set through the CSSOM during a drag: downward slide in px.

cssClasses.name: --aui-bottom-sheet-live-height
cssClasses.description: Custom property set through the CSSOM during a drag with snap points: live height in px.
